title: Kairos: Semantics-Aware Orchestration of Planning Engines across Classical, Numeric, Temporal and Hybrid PDDL
abstract: arXiv:2610.39454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning at run time, as in robots that re-plan while they act, needs a planner that reads the PDDL its users write (durative actions, numeric resources, time windows, continuous change), answers quickly, and delivers only validated plans. Specialised planners are strong on individual fragments of PDDL, but they differ in coverage, latency and in what their failures mean. We study whether selecting heterogeneous engines from the semantics of each task can give broad coverage of PDDL, from STRIPS to PDDL+, while remaining competitive with specialised planners and making explicit what each answer guarantees. Kairos profiles each task to decide which of five engines apply (ground heuristic search, compressed and snap-action temporal search, time steps for hybrid dynamics, lifted search) and schedules them under one budget of time and memory. translated_title: Kairos：跨越经典、数值、时序与混合PDDL的语义感知规划引擎编排
translated_abstract: 运行时规划（例如机器人在执行动作的同时重新规划）需要一个能够读取用户所编写PDDL（包括持续动作、数值资源、时间窗口、连续变化）的规划器，能够快速响应，并且只返回经过验证的计划。专业化规划器在PDDL的各个独立片段上表现出色，但它们在覆盖范围、延迟以及失败含义上各不相同。我们研究是否能够根据每个任务的语义选择异构引擎，从而实现对PDDL从STRIPS到PDDL+的广泛覆盖，同时保持与专业化规划器相当的竞争力，并明确说明每个答案所提供的保证。Kairos对每个任务进行特征分析，以确定五个引擎中哪些适用（基础启发式搜索、压缩及快照动作时序搜索、面向混合动力学的时间步进搜索、提升式搜索），并在统一的时间和内存预算下对它们进行调度。每个候选计划都由一个独立于规划器内部转换的验证器进行检查，而“未……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Kairos通过分析任务语义，智能调度五种异构规划引擎，实现对从STRIPS到PDDL+的广泛PDDL片段覆盖，在统一的时间和内存预算下运行，并通过独立验证器确保所有返回计划的有效性。
en_tdlr: Kairos profiles task semantics to orchestrate five heterogeneous planning engines, achieving broad PDDL coverage from STRIPS to PDDL+ under a unified time and memory budget, with all returned plans validated by an independent validator.
